resources.string: Forward IPv6 through TAP. Addresses and routes depend on router advertisements from the VPN-side network. Reconnect to apply changes.
Stop forwarding IPv6 frames through TAP. Reconnect to refresh the system addresses and routes.
Forward IPv6 through TUN when the VPN provides a usable IPv6 address and default route. IPv4 remains connected if either is missing. Check the home page for IPv6 status.
Forward the advertised VPN IPv6 subnet through TUN. Other destinations use the original network. IPv4 remains connected if no usable subnet is available. Check the home page for IPv6 status.
IPv6 forwarding is off. Apps using the VPN cannot reach IPv6 destinations.
IPv6 forwarding is off. IPv6 traffic uses the original network.
This switch applies only to its matching TAP or TUN access method.
Forward IPv6 according to destination routing. The VPN must provide a usable IPv6 address and the required routes. Reconnect to apply changes.
IPv6 traffic uses the original network. Enable IPv6 forwarding to use IPv6 address or subnet rules. Reconnect to apply changes.
Apps using the VPN cannot reach IPv6 destinations. Enable IPv6 forwarding to use IPv6 address or subnet rules. Reconnect to apply changes.
Destination routing settings are invalid. Open destination routing to review and save them.
